prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Sign-in hints, preset customization fallback flow, interactive wait tips/stage flow, pre-path story reordering, hotkey setup screen, and quick-action redesign were helpful.
Hints outside of sign-in, copy updates, layout changes, and sign-in reordering showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Most new screens showed no clear effect or hurt performance, with the exception of the interactive desktop hotkey setup screen.
Predictions overestimated gains for changes that showed no clear effect or hurt performance.
Predictions underestimated gains for unexpected winning changes with low or negative predictions, such as the hotkey setup screen, quick-action redesign, story reordering, and waiting stage flow.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Pet Trait Sound Calibration Flow: Rebuilds the companion selection flow on pick_friend with interactive audio preview controls for pet voices and traits. (why: Adoption stage has the biggest dropoff in early funnel (62.7% conversion), and users report post-onboarding confusion regarding talking to and controlling pets.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Existing Pet Data Recovery Notification Hint: Displays a clear sign-in hint explaining that logging in automatically restores all existing pets, customization data, and saved states. (why: 8 support emails (the single largest theme) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Pet Quick Practice Interaction Checklist Flow: Introduces a step-by-step practice interaction checklist on home_intro to verify desktop pet summoning and hotkeys. (why: Finish stage median is 395s with 76.3% conversion, and interactive practice components have proven to beat simple copy/layout edits.)
3: [home, notification] Desktop Generation Status System Tray Notification Alert: Enables a system notification option on the waiting screen to alert users on their desktop when pet rendering finishes. (why: Waiting stage takes 201s median / 2336s mean, leading users to switch away and fail to see when the pet is ready on desktop.)

scores.note: Adoption stage has the lowest conversion (62.7%), but new flows in adoption consistently underperform (-1.1% avg over 6 tests).
Sign-in hints average +2.4% over 10 tests and directly address the #1 support mail theme (8 emails).
Finish step loses 23.7% of users; while practice/hotkey flows can work, new screens generally carry negative average lift.
High wait time (201s median) causes dropoff; wait_info improvements reliably yield +1.1% lift over 7 tests.
